name: Family Office of America Inc.
summary: Family Office of America, Inc. is building an integrated family office platform through the acquisition and operation of accounting, tax, bookkeeping and related professional service businesses. The Company's strategy is to acquire established businesses, leverage shared infrastructure and technology, and expand the range of services offered to clients. The company was formerly known as Qualis Innovations, Inc. and changed its name to Family Office of America Inc. in December 2024.
